name: crumple-toss
title: Crumple Toss
description: A card crumples into a paper wad in stop-motion poses and is tossed into a bin: the old way, thrown away.
useWhen: An outdated process, old way or rejected idea should visibly be crumpled up and thrown away before the new one appears.
A paper, stop-motion look is wanted.
avoidWhen: The card must stay legible while it leaves: this destroys it.
You want a smooth, digital exit rather than discrete stop-motion poses.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Card text
variables.default: Six steps and a wiki page

variables.label: Start frame
variables.description: Frame (30 fps) where the crumple begins.

variables.label: Crumple poses
variables.description: Number of poses the crumple takes.

variables.label: Toss poses
variables.description: Number of poses the toss takes.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Launch angle of the toss in degrees (negative is up and to the right).

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far the wad is thrown, at design size.

variables.label: Spin
variables.description: Degrees the wad turns in flight.

variables.label: Layers
variables.description: Rings of wedges from the middle outwards.

variables.label: Crush to
variables.description: Size of the wad relative to the card.

variables.label: Frames per pose
variables.description: How many frames each pose is held.
